purpose: Immutable qualification receipt for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 serving with the Infernal Invocation r4 CUDA 13.3 and PyTorch 2.13 source composition

validation_environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 97887 MiB
validation_environment.topology: Sixteen-GPU host with PCIe switches; each qualification case used an isolated TP2 or TP4 GPU subset.

tests.release_composition: pass: release-composition and CUDA 13.3 release-contract scripts
tests.vllm_request_classification: pass: 50 focused unit tests in pull request 298
tests.target_only: pass: TP2 startup, exact arithmetic, C1/C4 decode, and four target FULL CUDA graph sizes
tests.fixed_k5: pass: TP2 long-agent soak with native tiered KV; TP4 exact arithmetic, C8 decode, 8k/64k prefill, coding workload, eight target FULL graphs, eight DSpark FULL graphs, and nine DFlash context-KV FULL graphs
tests.fixed_k7: pass: TP2 exact arithmetic, four target FULL graphs, four DSpark FULL graphs, and seven DFlash context-KV FULL graphs
tests.confidence_controlled_k7: pass: TP2 exact arithmetic, compact varlen capacity verification, 17 target FULL graphs, 28 DSpark FULL graphs, and seven DFlash context-KV FULL graphs
tests.strict_long_context_tools: pass: concurrent 150003-token and 300128-token strict-tool requests with independent valid tool-call output
tests.lmcache_filesystem_l2: pass: local prefix reset, L1 clear, and 15872-token filesystem-L2 replay
tests.runtime_error_scan: pass: no traceback, engine initialization failure, CUDA runtime error, or response-integrity violation in qualified runs

lmcache_filesystem_l2.conditions: TP2/DCP1 target-only, 2 GiB L1, 8 GiB filesystem L2, and 512-token chunks

limitations: Performance values describe the recorded PCIe-switch host and selected GPU subsets; they do not claim identical throughput on direct-root-port or dual-socket topologies.
Fixed K7 and confidence-controlled K7 are functionally and CUDA-graph qualified. Their workload-specific throughput and quality are not promoted over fixed probabilistic K5 by this receipt.
The K7 functional gate used an 8192-token maximum model length because the selected TP2 memory budget could not hold the 131072-token KV target together with the K7 graph envelope.

Single-stream DSpark throughput changes with workload phase and draft acceptance. Use the recorded coding workload and concurrency results instead of one arbitrary long C1 stream as a general performance claim.
LMCache replay was qualified with speculative decoding disabled so cache movement and draft acceptance remained independent variables.
The complete throughput sweep across context lengths and concurrency levels remains separate from this release correctness gate.
